140: def approved_chain_seeds(ref):
141:     """APPROVED ANATOMICAL CHAIN CONTEXT: one seed per digit, placed at the distal end of the
142:     APPROVED joint polyline of that digit (the same frozen joint-frame chain that every
143:     Stage5B / Stage6A / Stage6B script uses to build its arc coordinate), plus the approved
144:     wrist origin vertex.
145: 
146:     The seeds are deliberately taken from the approved CHAIN, not from any contested
147:     semantic region, so that the partition is not self-fulfilling.
148:     """
149:     V0 = ref["V0"]
150:     AC = ref["AC"]
151:     seeds = {}
152:     for D in DIGITS5:
153:         seeds[D] = nearest_vertex(V0, AC[D][-1])
154:     seeds["wrist"] = nearest_vertex(V0, AC["wrist"][0])
155:     return seeds

158: def r2_partition(ctx, ref, margin_threshold_mm=None, max_sweeps=40,
159:                  thumb_seed_mode="approved_distal_cap"):
160:     """MULTI_SOURCE_GEODESIC_DIGIT_PARTITION (mesh-topology aware).
161: 
162:     Two deterministic stages:
163:       1. exact multi-source Dijkstra over the real mesh edge graph;
164:       2. MESH_TOPOLOGY_AWARE disambiguation -- a label flip is only accepted where the
165:          geodesic evidence is decisive.  A vertex whose nearest-source margin (2nd-nearest
166:          minus nearest source distance) is below the mesh edge scale tau = one median edge
167:          length carries NO usable evidence (the two candidate chains are effectively
168:          equidistant, which is exactly the Stage6B R1A "random flip" signature), so it
169:          inherits the majority label of its already-decisive neighbours.  Iterated to a
170:          fixed point; deterministic.
171:     """
172:     V0 = ref["V0"]
173:     EDGES = ref["EDGES"]
174:     adjw = mesh_graph(V0, EDGES)
175:     adj = dict((k, [t[0] for t in v]) for k, v in adjw.items())
176:     seeds = approved_chain_seeds(ref)
177:     if thumb_seed_mode == "approved_distal_cap":
178:         seeds["THUMB"] = nearest_vertex(V0, sum(
179:             (V0[i] for i in ref["cap"]["thumb_cap_vertex_ids"]), Vector()) /
180:             len(ref["cap"]["thumb_cap_vertex_ids"]))
181:     gs = dict((k, dijkstra_multi(adjw, [v])) for k, v in seeds.items())
182:     NV = ref["NV"]
183:     order_all = []
184:     for i in range(NV):
185:         order_all.append(sorted(gs.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1].get(i, 1e18)))
186:     raw = [o[0][0] for o in order_all]
187:     margins = [rr((o[1][1].get(i, 1e18) - o[0][1].get(i, 1e18)) * MM, 6)
188:                for i, o in enumerate(order_all)]
189:     tau = ref["med_edge"]                       # mm
190:     thr = tau if margin_threshold_mm is None else margin_threshold_mm
191:     part = list(raw)
192:     decisive = [i for i in range(NV) if margins[i] >= thr]
193:     ambiguous = [i for i in range(NV) if margins[i] < thr]
194:     relabelled = []
195:     fixed = set(decisive)
196:     for _ in range(max_sweeps):
197:         nxt = set(fixed)
198:         changed = 0
199:         for i in ambiguous:
200:             cnt = {}
201:             for u in adj.get(i, ()):
202:                 if u in fixed:
203:                     cnt[part[u]] = cnt.get(part[u], 0) + 1
204:             if not cnt:
205:                 continue
206:             best = sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[0][0]
207:             if best != part[i]:
208:                 part[i] = best
209:                 changed += 1
210:                 relabelled.append(i)
211:                 nxt.add(i)
212:         fixed = nxt
213:         if changed == 0:
214:             break
215:     return {"partition": part, "raw_partition": raw, "seeds": seeds, "margin_mm": margins,
216:             "thumb_seed_mode": thumb_seed_mode,

269:       (b) every vertex whose label change is inside the {THUMB, INDEX} transition family,
270:     closed over the same-corrected-digit 1-ring and (only where the trusted-neighbour count is
